name: Per-task PBGD selection + reg(MLP)
tagline: Pick V-PBGD (toy + linear) vs G-PBGD with $L_2$ regularization for MLP, with hand-tuned $\gamma_{max}$, ramp, and step counts.

key_hyperparams.name: mlp reg
key_hyperparams.role: $L_2$ on inner parameters for strong convexity

init_recovers: V-PBGD or G-PBGD baseline at the listed hparams
diff_from_baseline: No new algorithm; tunes $(\gamma_{max}, \text{ramp}, \text{outer steps})$ and adds an inner-$L_2$ regularizer for the MLP variant; routes by network type (V-PBGD for linear, G-PBGD for MLP).

name: Normalized adaptive PBGD
tagline: On the toy, run V-PBGD with $\sqrt{\gamma}$ step size and unit-norm gradient direction; on MNIST keep V-/G-PBGD with paper-style hparams.
init_recovers: V-PBGD with $\alpha = \alpha_0/\gamma$ when normalize_grad=false and the $\sqrt{}$ rescaling is removed
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the toy outer step from $\alpha_0/\gamma$ to $\alpha_0/\sqrt{\gamma}$ and applies gradient-direction normalization; for MLP picks G-PBGD with the V-PBGD-style ramp = 30k.

name: Adam-PBGD on toy + $\|\nabla_y g\|$ penalty
tagline: Adam optimizer (with bias correction and per-$\gamma$ momentum reset) for the toy, and an $\ell_2$-norm gradient penalty (not squared) with Adam optimizers on hyperclean.

key_hyperparams.name: linear $(\eta_x, \eta_y, \gamma_{max}, \text{ramp})$
key_hyperparams.role: Adam steps + V-PBGD ramp on linear

key_hyperparams.name: mlp $(\eta_x, \eta_y, \gamma_{max}, \text{ramp})$
key_hyperparams.role: Adam steps + G-PBGD ramp on MLP

init_recovers: Plain SGD-style PBGD when Adam reduces to identity ($\beta_1=0, \beta_2=0$) and the gradient penalty is squared back
diff_from_baseline: Replaces SGD with bias-corrected Adam in both the toy and hyperclean updates, and replaces the squared $\|\nabla_\theta g\|^2$ penalty with the (smoothed) $\ell_2$-norm $\sqrt{\|\nabla_\theta g\|^2 + \epsilon}$.

name: V-PBGD/G-PBGD per-task baselines
tagline: Pick V-PBGD for toy and linear, G-PBGD for MLP with longer 80k outer steps, otherwise paper hparams.
init_recovers: V-PBGD / G-PBGD baseline exactly at these hparams
diff_from_baseline: Pure hparam selection inside the V-/G-PBGD family; main change is doubling the MLP G-PBGD outer iterations (80k vs 50k baseline) and bumping toy $\alpha_0$ from 0.1 to 0.12.

name: Routing PBGD by problem class
tagline: Dispatch by `task` and `net_name`: V-PBGD for toy and linear, G-PBGD for MLP, otherwise paper hparams.
init_recovers: V-PBGD baseline if MLP also runs V-PBGD
diff_from_baseline: Same updates as the V-PBGD and G-PBGD baselines but routed by problem class: toy and linear go to V-PBGD, MLP goes to G-PBGD; hparams essentially unchanged.
